title: Background images, repeat, position, size, attachment
learningObjectives: Explain background images, repeat, position, size, attachment and apply it correctly in a small CSS example.

understand.concept: CSS background-image can place an image or gradient behind an element's content. Related properties control repetition, position, size, and attachment. background-size: cover fills the box while preserving aspect ratio, which may crop the image; contain fits the whole image and may leave empty space.
understand.whyItMatters: Background images are decorative and do not provide alternative text to assistive technology. Important information should be real content, such as an img with appropriate alt text. A background can be combined with a colour fallback.
understand.analogy: A background is like a page's wallpaper: it can decorate a space, but a key instruction should not exist only on the wallpaper.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy helps build intuition, but the browser follows the CSS specifications and computed-style rules rather than human intentions.

explain.narrative: The fallback colour and gradient remain defined even if the illustrative image cannot load. Replace the example URL with an image you are allowed to use.
